Scenario fixture: contrast-minimum-rgaa (RGAA 3.2.1 to 3.2.4)

Each target has a stable id of the form cmr_case_NN. RGAA 3.2 asks for 4.5:1, or 3:1 for text of 24px or more and bold text of 18.5px or more. #888888 on white is 3.54:1; #aaaaaa on white is 2.32:1.

A. Below RGAA's threshold (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: 16px regular text at 3.54:1 (3.2.1 needs 4.5:1)

02 — FAIL: 18px bold text at 3.54:1 (3.2.2 needs 4.5:1)

Opening hours

03 — FAIL: 18.5px bold text at 2.32:1 (3.2.4 needs 3:1)

Opening hours

B. At or above RGAA's threshold (PASS)

04 — PASS: 18.5px bold text at 3.54:1 (3.2.4, although WCAG fails it)

Opening hours

05 — PASS: 18.67px bold text at 3.54:1

Opening hours
